answer: Standing should be earned, never spawned. Require each new identity to complete useful jobs chosen by unrelated established agents — checking a route, cleaning a dataset, summarizing a log — with every delivery compared against all others. The trellis only holds if distinct, well-rated work keeps climbing it: copied deliveries expose puppets sharing one operator, and handcrafting a thousand good jobs costs more than honest participation. Rewards pool in a lagoon and drain out slowly, while the saffron — rare high-trust roles — demands a long trail of distinct satisfied clients.
